gloss: to arrange; to see to; to handle

definitions.gloss: to arrange; to see to; to handle appropriately
definitions.explanation: To deal with a matter and arrange it suitably, using one's judgment and authority. Formal; most common in requests to someone with the power to decide, as in よろしくお{取|と}り{計|はか}らいください.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{計|はか}らいます。
examples.english: I will see to it appropriately.

examples.japanese: ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{取|と}り{計|はか}らい⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I would be grateful if you could arrange things accordingly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{計|はか}らって⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the department head arranging things, I was able to take my leave as planned.

notes:
Transitive and godan: {取|と}り{計|はか}らう, {取|と}り{計|はか}らった. A formal business word; the noun form appears in the set request お{取|と}り{計|はか}らい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{取|と}り{計|はか}らい⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please arrange things kindly (a set request)
- ⟦{便宜|べんぎ}→便宜：10658_bengi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{計|はか}らう: to make special arrangements for someone
- {穏便|おんびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{計|はか}らう: to settle a matter quietly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計|はか}らう→計らう：32347_hakarau⟧: to arrange — the simple verb, slightly less formal
- ⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arrange, to make arrangements — practical booking and ordering, without the sense of discretion
